headers.//: Covers are keyed by YouTube video ID. A given ID's artwork never changes — different cover means different track, so a different filename.
The plates have stable names and can change when `npm run art` re-renders them: a day of freshness, then a week of serving the old copy while the new one is fetched.
The page embeds a YouTube player and nothing else. Deny what it does not need, and never let the site be framed by someone else.
